title: Liberal or conservative oxygen therapy for ventilated patients in the ICU: a meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials.

evidence.reason: Inventory must identify exactly k distinct trials

answer.design_quote: The included studies in the meta-analysis met the following criteria: (1) randomized controlled trials; (2) subjects in studies were patients admitted in ICU who were expected to remain mechanically ventilated; (3) the patients were assigned to receive either COT or LOT;
answer.k_quote: A total of 7 RCTs were included, with 2166 patients admitted to the ICU.
